title: Create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as Instant Form
content_data:
This article introduces how to create a Lead Generation ad with optimization location as Instant Form, driving lead-related actions on the Instant Form that loads natively within TikTok. # Prerequisite 1. Create an Instant Form. To create an Instant Form, use [Instant Page Editor SDK](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740307202170881) and set `businessType` to `1`. 2. Call [/page/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826387779586) to get the page ID via `page_id`. # Steps ## 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {30%} | Parameter {20%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---|---| | Advertising objective | Lead Generation | `objective_type` | `LEAD_GENERATION` | | Smart+ Campaign | Disabled

To learn about how to create a Smart+ Lead Generation Campaign with optimization location as Instant Form, see [Create Smart+ Lead Generation Campaigns](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1827645480080385#item-link-Create%20a%20Smart+%20Lead%20Generation%20Campaign%20with%20optimization%20location%20as%20Instant%20Form). | / | / | ``` ### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget": {{budget}} }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "objective": "LANDING_PAGE", "roas_bid": 0, "budget": {{budget}}, "secondary_status": "CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLE", "is_smart_performance_campaign": false, "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "deep_bid_type": null, "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "is_new_structure": true, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "objective_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "operation_status": "ENABLE" } } (/code) ``` ## 2. Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114). Note that the following requirements must be met. ``` xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {22%} | Parameter {28%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---| | Optimization location
(Promotion type) | Instant Form | `promotion_type`
`promotion_target_type`|
  • Set `promotion_type` to `LEAD_GENERATION`
  • AND set `promotion_target_type` to `INSTANT_PAGE` or do not pass this field
| | Deep funnel optimization
(Optional) |Enabled or disabled

With deep funnel optimization, you can select a secondary event alongside the primary optimization event, which can help improve campaign effectiveness.| `deep_funnel_optimization_status`
`deep_funnel_event_source`
`deep_funnel_event_source_id`
`deep_funnel_optimization_event` |
  • To enable deep funnel optimization, set `deep_funnel_optimization_status` to `ON` and pass `deep_funnel_event_source`, `deep_funnel_event_source_id`, and `deep_funnel_optimization_event`.
  • To disable deep funnel optimization, set `deep_funnel_optimization_status` to `OFF` or leave `deep_funnel_optimization_status` unspecified. Do not pass `deep_funnel_event_source`,`deep_funnel_event_source_id`, and `deep_funnel_optimization_event`.

Note:

  • Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
  • Deep funnel optimization with Pixel or Offline events is generally available.
| | Placement |Any of the following options:
  • Automatic Placement
  • Select Placement with TikTok placement, or Pangle placement, or TikTok and Pangle placement

Note: Pangle placement for Lead Generation ads with optimization location as Instant Form is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.| `placement_type`
`placements` | Any of the following configurations:

  • Set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC`
  • Set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`, and set `placements` to ` ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]`, or `["PLACEMENT_PANGLE"]`, or ` ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK","PLACEMENT_PANGLE"]`.
| | Location targeting | Specify locations supported for the Lead Generation objective and placement setting | `location_ids` | Call [/tool/region/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737189539571713) first. Set `objective_type` to `LEAD_GENERATION` and pass `placements`. Then select the location IDs you want to target from the supported location IDs returned through the `location_id` parameter. | | Age targeting | Audiences younger than 18 years old can't be targeted. | `age_groups` | Do not pass the value `AGE_13_17`. | | Pangle audience packages
(Optional) | Supported | `included_pangle_audience_package_ids`
`excluded_pangle_audience_package_ids`| Supported.

Note: Using Pangle audience packages in this scenario is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative. | | Targeting expansion | Cannot expand to target audiences younger than 18 years ago | `expansion_enabled`
`expansion_types`
{-To be deprecated} | If you set `expansion_enabled` to `true` and include `AGE` in the values of `expansion_types`, the call won't fail but you still can't target audiences younger than 18 years. | | Optimization goal | Form submission | `optimization_goal` | `LEAD_GENERATION` | | Billing event | oCPM | `billing_event` | `OCPM` | | Bid strategy & Delivery Type |

  • If Bid Strategy is set to Cost Cap, you can set Delivery Type to Standard or Accelerated.
  • If Bid Strategy is set to Maximum Delivery, you can only set Delivery Type to Standard.
| `bid_type`
`pacing` |
  • If you specify `bid_type` as `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`, you can set `pacing` to `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` or `PACING_MODE_FAST`.
  • If you specify `bid_type` as `BID_TYPE_NO_BID`, you can only set `pacing` to `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH`.
| ``` ### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/adgroup/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "promotion_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "placement_type": "PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL", "placements": ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"], "video_download_disabled": false, "location_ids": ["{{location_id}}"], "operating_systems": ["ANDROID"], "gender": "GENDER_UNLIMITED", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget": {{budget}}, "schedule_type": "SCHEDULE_START_END", "schedule_start_time": "{{schedule_start_time}}", "schedule_end_time": "{{schedule_end_time}}", "optimization_goal": "LEAD_GENERATION", "bid_type": "BID_TYPE_NO_BID", "billing_event": "OCPM", "pacing": "PACING_MODE_SMOOTH" }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "conversion_bid_price": 0, "actions": [], "promotion_type": "LEAD_GENERATION", "app_type": null, "pixel_id": null, "adgroup_app_profile_page_state": null, "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "feed_type": null, "auto_targeting_enabled": false, "frequency": null, "location_ids": [ "{{location_id}}" ], "purchased_reach": null, "rf_estimated_cpr": null, "schedule_type": "SCHEDULE_START_END", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "schedule_infos": null, "brand_safety_partner": null, "comment_disabled": false, "category_exclusion_ids": [], "is_new_structure": true, "category_id": "0", "adgroup_name": "{{adgroup_name}}", "placement_type": "PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL", "app_download_url": null, "app_id": null, "languages": [], "optimization_event": "FORM", "operating_systems": [ "ANDROID" ], "schedule_start_time": "{{schedule_start_time}}", "video_download_disabled": false, "secondary_status": "ADGROUP_STATUS_CREATE", "keywords": null, "deep_cpa_bid": 0, "is_hfss": false, "bid_display_mode": "CPMV", "frequency_schedule": null, "bid_price": 0, "conversion_window": null, "billing_event": "OCPM", "audience_ids": [], "budget": {{budget}}, "deep_bid_type": null, "isp_ids": [], "interest_category_ids": [], "skip_learning_phase": true, "placements": [ "PLACEMENT_TIKTOK" ], "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "schedule_end_time": "{{schedule_end_time}}", "rf_estimated_frequency": null, "age_groups": [ "AGE_18_24", "AGE_25_34", "AGE_35_44", "AGE_45_54", "AGE_55_100" ], "inventory_filter_enabled": false, "bid_type": "BID_TYPE_NO_BID", "operation_status": "ENABLE", "gender": "GENDER_UNLIMITED", "secondary_optimization_event": null, "share_disabled": false, "network_types": [] } } (/code) ``` ## 3. Create an ad Create an ad using [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting {20%} | Requirement {30%} | Parameter {20%} | How to configure the parameter {30%} | |---|---|---|---| | Ad format | Any of the following types:
  • Single video
  • Carousel images

Note: To set ad format to Carousel images, you need to specify the placement as Automatic Placement or Select Placement with TikTok placement included at the ad group level. | `ad_format` | Any of the following values:

  • `SINGLE_VIDEO`
  • `CAROUSEL_ADS`

Note: To set `ad_format` to `CAROUSEL_ADS`, either specify `placement_type` as `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or specify `placement_type` as `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and include `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` in the value of `placements` at the ad group level first.

  • To learn about how to create Standard Carousel Ads, see [Steps for creating Standard Carousel Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1766217791987713#item-link-Steps%20for%20creating%20Standard%20Carousel%20Ads).
| | Interactive add-on
(Optional for single video ads) |
  • When ad format is single video and the placement includes TikTok, the only supported type is Display Card.
  • When ad format is Carousel images, interactive add-ons are not supported.
| `card_id` |
  • When `ad_format` is `SINGLE_VIDEO` and at the ad group level `placement_type` is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_AUTOMATIC` or `placement_type`is `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL` and `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK` is included in the value of `placements`, you can specify the Display Card ID.
    • To learn about how to get the Display Card ID, refer to [Cards](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1749019652141058).
  • When `ad_format` is `CAROUSEL_ADS`, `card_id` is not supported.
| | Destination | Instant Form | `page_id` | Specify the ID of an Instant Form.

  • To obtain the ID of an Instant Form, set `business_type` to `LEAD_GEN` in [/page/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826387779586).
  • To create an Instant Form, use [Instant Page Editor SDK](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740307202170881) and set `businessType` to `1`.
| ``` ### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/ad/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "adgroup_id": "{{adgroup_id}}", "creatives": [{ "ad_name": "{{ad_name}}", "identity_type":"CUSTOMIZED_USER", "page_id":"{{page_id}}" }] }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "ad_ids": [ "{{ad_id}}" ], "need_audit": seo_title: Create a Manual TikTok Lead Generation ad using Instant Form
seo_description: Find out the steps for creating a Manual Lead Generation ad with optimization location as Instant Form. Read the guide to help you get the task done right.
